comment: The section states that the two layers describe the full scope of DPI-H application components. This may prematurely close the architecture to additional shared components, such as consent, trust, service directories, organisation identifiers, notification services, document registries, or future nationally shared capabilities.

anchor.note: p.71 l.Lines 713-718 read as the printed page; section 3.5.3.2 agrees

public.text: The section states that the two layers describe the full scope of DPI-H application components. This may prematurely close the architecture to additional shared components, such as consent, trust, service directories, organisation identifiers, notification services, document registries, or future nationally shared capabilities.
public.suggestedRevision: Describe the catalogue as the component set identified in the current release, subject to governed extension and revision. Publish criteria and a process for proposing, assessing, adding, merging, or retiring components.
